title: The Wider Circle --- Wife, Uncle, Aunt, Cousin
label: ch:esposos-y-tios
canDo: I can name a wife, an uncle, an aunt and a cousin in Spanish, in either gender, and I know why Spanish and English chose different ancient words for the same relatives.
